name: rideops
description: A private platform for recording bike rides and exploring GPX routes.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@rideops/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@rideops/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
